title: Arrays
instructions: An array is a row of boxes, all the same type, under one name.
int nums[5] makes room for 5 ints. You reach each one by its position number, called an index.
Big surprise for beginners: indexes start at 0, not 1. So the first box is nums[0], the second is nums[1], and so on.
You can read a box (nums[2]) or change it (nums[1] = 99).
A for loop is the usual way to walk through every box.
task: Fill in the index so the program prints the THIRD element (30).
hint:
The third box is index 2, because counting starts at 0:

    nums[2]
